name: Default
shortDescription: Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents schema exploration, read-only or full SQL access, explain plans, index tuning and health checks on an existing PostgreSQL database over SSE.

alerts.message: Set DATABASE_URI to the connection URI of the PostgreSQL database the agents should work on (it must be reachable from this server), then redeploy. Until then every tool call fails.

Point your MCP client at https://<your-domain>/sse with the SSE transport and send an Authorization: Bearer header with the generated POSTGRES_MCP_TOKEN from the environment settings. Requests without it get 401.
